## Does it fit the project's constraints?

This project deliberately has **no build step, no frontend framework and no external CDN**.
Ideas that need heavyweight dependencies are usually better as a separate service that
consumes the REST API.

- [ ] Fits the "no build step" constraint
- [ ] Uses public data only (World Bank Open Data / China NBS / China Customs)
- [ ] Keeps the REST API bilingual (identifiers localized server-side, not in the browser)
